name: getpid
description: getpid() returns the process ID (PID) of the calling process, often used by routines that generate unique temporary filenames.

return_value.success: Returns the process ID of the calling process as pid_t

bugs: In glibc versions up to 2.24, getpid() cached PIDs, which could return incorrect values if applications bypassed glibc wrappers for fork(), vfork(), or clone(); this was fixed in glibc 2.25 by removing the cache.
versions: On Alpha, uses a single getxpid() system call; glibc 2.3.4 to 2.24 had PID caching issues; since glibc 2.25, caching is removed.
